# OpenPay Pro Wallet

> Self-custody Web3 wallet for the OpenPay ecosystem: hold OUSD and majors, swap, trade spot/perps, mint NFTs, send payments, and track every transaction on a public ledger.

## Developer portal

- [Developer Portal](/docs): Hub for every integration path.
- [Quickstart](/docs#quickstart): Ship Connect + payments in one afternoon.
- [Choose your path](/docs#paths): Exchange · Merchant · App · Agent.
- [Connect & payments](/docs/openpay): OAuth, PayButton, inbound, auth methods.
- [Exchange · OUSD](/docs/exchange): Deposit, withdraw, swap, reconcile.
- [Money rails](/docs/money): Send, receive, deposit, withdraw, swap.
- [Tokens & assets](/docs/tokens): OUSD, majors, OpenToken, NFT.
- [Partner Transfer API](/docs/api): Transfers, charges, OAuth token.
- [Public Ledger API](/docs/ledger): Append-only transaction mirror.
- [Agent Connect · MCP](/docs/mcp): Tools for ChatGPT, Claude, agents.
- [FAQ](/docs/faq): Wallets, fees, partner teaser.
- [Errors & retries](/docs/errors): HTTP codes, polling, idempotency.
- [Authentication](/docs/auth): Seven Pro methods + Connect OAuth.
- [Raw markdown feeds](/docs#raw): Machine-readable docs under /api/public/docs/*.

## Product pages

- [Sign in](/authpi): OpenPay, Pi, Solana, Phantom, MetaMask, WalletConnect, or Telegram.
- [Transfer Pi guide](/guides/transfer-pi): How to transfer Pi Network assets into OpenPay Pro.
- [Wiki](/wiki): End-user tutorials.
- [Claim Test Pi](/testnet-reward): Pi Testnet reward claim page.
